objective: Focused literature/theory recurrence on the stronger V29 baseline. First identify which joint-source and fourth-response terms its published equations already contain; then derive one coherent omitted response without double counting. Prioritize a cheap paired-fourth or conditional-source correction native to V29, keeping response-equivalent homogeneous state as a larger-upside reserve. Proposed floors: 120 minutes written derivation, 30 focused adjacent literature, 30 candidate selection; estimate 180–220 elapsed minutes, with productive continuation allowed. A cheap candidate may be saved while a credible larger-gain thread is developed. No new task, candidate execution or agents start automatically.

Written mathematics and small generated checks without challenge inputs or targets
